text: I follow the stones down to the ford. When I spot Dann, I call his name and hold up his oilcloth so he'll know who it is.
intent_before_narration: Finish the interrupted walk on foot and find Dann; show the oilcloth.

text: Tam is breathing easier and Wren is there. Thank you for the loan, Dann. I hand the hooded oilcloth back to him now.
intent_before_narration: Deliberately return the same item to Dann after merely showing it.

text: I'll stand clear on the dry bank, Dann. If Berta's team balks, where does she need a pair of hands on this side?
intent_before_narration: Stay on the near bank, offer non-monetary help and leave the oilcloth with Dann.

text: I tell Berta what Dann said about the cairns. I'll help get the mare and her cart back from the water on our side; I don't cross the ford.
intent_before_narration: Help the waiting cart on dry land. Explicitly decline crossing, retain ownership from prior turn.

text: He's breathing easier. I heard Wren say it myself, not a rumor from the ford. If your cart goes by the Hallorans, could you take me as far as their gate?
intent_before_narration: Confirm only what I know; ask for a ride if Berta is already going past the family.

text: I'm up. I climb into the place behind Berta's seat for the ride to the Halloran gate, and keep my hands to the tailframes as she asked.
intent_before_narration: Accept the offered ride to the gate; authorize that destination only and no payment.

text: I say nothing about money and keep my hands off my staff. Berta, it's your cart; if there's a way back rather than straight through them, I'll help you turn the mare.
intent_before_narration: Refuse to volunteer payment or attack, leave route decision to cart owner and offer safe retreat.

text: I give the mare room, take the near trace where Berta indicates, and help turn the cart back along the road we came. No toll and no fight for me.
intent_before_narration: Attempt retreat with the owner's consent, no payment, no appropriation of the cart or gear.
